name: KAIST Multispectral Pedestrian Detection Benchmark
description: KAIST Multispectral Pedestrian Dataset is a comprehensive benchmark for day and night pedestrian detection, consisting of 95,328 well-aligned color (RGB) and thermal (infrared) image pairs captured from vehicle-mounted sensors in campus, street, and countryside environments.

publisher.name: KAIST (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology)

license.name: Custom Non-Commercial Academic License
license.notes: Freely available for non-commercial research and educational use upon agreement to cite the publication.

source_references.title: Multispectral Pedestrian Detection: Benchmark Dataset and Baselines

verification.notes: Verified against CVPR 2015 publication (DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2015.7298706) and official KAIST portal. Exactly 95,328 aligned color-thermal image pairs (train: 50,187 pairs across set00-set05; test: 45,141 pairs across set06-set11) with 103,128 dense pedestrian bounding box annotations.

size.notes: RGB and thermal image sequences and text annotation files.
